## Description {#details}

<p>Utility class for integer operators which may exhibit overflow - Add, Sub, Mul, and Shl.</p>


<p>It does not include SDiv, despite that operator having the potential for overflow.</p>


<p>Definition at line 77 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/operator-h">Operator.h</a>.</p>
